contracts.point: 5daae0 resolves byte lookup[logicalIndex] through hierarchy+18c, then80-byte point records at hierarchy+184. It multiplies point.localMatrix by jointWorld[point.byte44], stores a float32 matrix, then multiplies that matrix by objectWorld. Two matrix stores and their rounding are preserved.
contracts.pcJoint255: The PC code has no joint255 sentinel branch: it directly indexes jointWorld[255]. All26 such authored points are checked with an explicitly supplied synthetic finite slot255. Their26 packet/output bindings are disabled because ordinary computed hierarchy arrays do not supply that slot. The Android local-only behavior is not transplanted.
contracts.outputs: 62e1e0 checks both output pointers before reading model. With either output present it visits exactly16slots and tests uint model+14+4*i againstzero. Each enabled slot writes XYZ from the final matrix translation and/or all16 matrixvalues. Disabled slots preserve prior destination bits.
contracts.packet: SkeletalPoints.EvaluatePacket extends the recovered default-layer62e290 branch. It computes the skeletal pose then enabled POI outputs, leaving AnimationPacket bytes untouched. An empty layer selection preserves every destination. Morph output remains null.
contracts.authoredAdapter: All688 rigs and3746 point records are source-byte/hash bound. Directpoint cases supply a synthetic one-entry lookup to exercise every record, including unreferenced points. Packet/output enable words are explicit fixture inputs based on valid observed lookups; they are not claimed to reconstruct native model initialization.
contracts.matrixPolicy: Original game matrix calls execute the original installed d3dx9_35 scalar implementation under the explicit policy in animation-skeletal-contract.json. CPU/OS dispatch is not inferred.
